                 !(GHC.Internal.Maybe.Maybe Data.Text.Internal.Text)
                 !(GHC.Internal.Maybe.Maybe Data.Text.Internal.Text)
                 !EvidenceReadError
                 !GHC.Types.Bool
    | InvalidPinnedRevision !Data.Text.Internal.Text

                            !GHC.Types.Bool
    | ProvenanceMismatch !Shikigami.Repository.RepositoryId

                         !Shikigami.Repository.RepositoryId
                         !Data.Text.Internal.Text
                         !GHC.Types.Bool
    | PathMismatch !Data.Text.Internal.Text
                   !Data.Text.Internal.Text
                   !GHC.Types.Bool
    | InvalidReturnedPath !Data.Text.Internal.Text
                          !Data.Text.Internal.Text
                          !GHC.Types.Bool
    | MissingContentHash !Data.Text.Internal.Text !GHC.Types.Bool
    | InvalidDeclaredSize !Data.Text.Internal.Text
                          {-# UNPACK #-}GHC.Types.Int
                          !GHC.Types.Bool
    | ContentSizeMismatch !Data.Text.Internal.Text
                          {-# UNPACK #-}GHC.Types.Int
                          {-# UNPACK #-}GHC.Types.Int
                          !GHC.Types.Bool
    | EvidenceLimitExceeded !Data.Text.Internal.Text

                            {-# UNPACK #-}GHC.Types.Int
                            !GHC.Types.Bool
    | InvalidGrepMatch !Data.Text.Internal.Text
                       {-# UNPACK #-}GHC.Types.Int
    | MixedReferenceRevisions !Shikigami.Repository.RepositoryId
                              ![Data.Text.Internal.Text]
    | ResolvedRepositoryMismatch !Shikigami.Repository.RepositoryId
                                 !Shikigami.Repository.RepositoryId
    | IncompatibleUpstreamVersion !Data.Text.Internal.Text
                                  !Data.Text.Internal.Text
    | MissingRequiredEvidence !Data.Text.Internal.Text
                              !Data.Text.Internal.Text
declarations.sourceDeclaration:
data EvidenceProblem
  = ReadFailed !RepositoryId !(Maybe Text) !(Maybe Text) !EvidenceReadError !Bool
